newsitem.title: USA: XCL Ltd sells $75 mln in 144a junk bonds. [corrected 15:50 gmt]
newsitem.headline: XCL Ltd sells $75 mln in 144a junk bonds. [corrected 15:50 gmt]

text.p: The following 144a private placement of high-yield bonds from XCL Ltd was priced on Tuesday (Corrects from Monday) via Jeffries & Co, according to market sources.
The debt was sold in units which also included warrants to purchase 12.5 percent of the company, they said.
Concurrent with the debt offering, the company also sold $25 million in 9.5 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock, which pays-in-kind (PIK) for the first three years.
XCL is a Louisiana-based oil and gas exploration and production company.
